text:
mike: heads-up PR 5234 shows a latency bump on long-seq benches after the KV cache patch. pinging eng-runtime for quick review. bench logs: https://ci.example.com/artifacts/5234/bench/results.txt

tara: taking a look. can you paste the exact command you ran?

mike: `./bench/run --model redwood-3B --seq 4096 --qps 50 --iters 100`

jason: i ran a microbatch sim locally and saw ~+8% p95 and +200MB RSS. suspect the eviction path added a serialized lock.

mike: snippet from bench output:```
old p95: 142ms -> new p95: 154ms
old throughput: 1160 tokens/s -> new: 1120 tokens/s
RSS: 8.4G -> 8.6G
```

lisa: can you bisect? which commit introduced it?

mike: bisect points to commit abc123 (merge from PR 5218) — kv-evict refactor.

tara: ok i'll add review comments on PR 5234 and request changes. who can re-run benches and approve after fix?

jason: i can re-run on my rig and sign off if numbers return to baseline.

ci-bot: perf-check failed for PR 5234 — diff: p95 +8% (142ms -> 154ms), throughput -3.4% :x:

mike: timeline? we should revert or patch today. it's a small API change. can we canary rollback or add a guard?

sre-oncall: if this hits prod traffic, enable fallback policy to previous model pool. we haven't breached SLOs yet but keep monitoring.

tara: i'll open a quick follow-up PR with a guard + unit test. assigning to jason for bench verification. tagging @jason

jason: ack — starting runs now, will post results in ~20m.

mike: thanks :thumbsup:

jason: results: p95 back to 143ms, throughput restored to ~1155 tokens/s, RSS back to 8.4G. looks like the guard fixes the regression. lgtm from perf side. :white_check_mark:

tara: filed PR 5240 with the guard and test, added jason as reviewer. will merge after lgtm.

mike: merging now and deploying to canary.

ci-bot: deploy to canary succeeded — canary metrics stable. https://deploys.example.com/canary/5240 :rocket:

sre-oncall: monitoring — no regression observed in the last 15m.

mike: closing thread, will follow up if anything pops up.
